<style>.cool{position:relative;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;font:800 15px Inter,sans-serif;background:var(--accent,#3366FF);padding:15px 30px;border-radius:12px}
.coolp{position:absolute;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none}</style>
<button class="cool" id="cool">Press me</button>
<script>var b=document.getElementById('cool'),cols=['#3366FF','#7A5CFF','#FFD36A','#fff'];
function burst(){var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();for(var i=0;i<16;i++){(function(){var p=document.createElement('span');p.className='coolp';p.style.background=cols[i%4];p.style.left=(b.offsetLeft+r.width/2)+'px';p.style.top=(b.offsetTop+r.height/2)+'px';b.parentNode.appendChild(p);var a=Math.random()*6.28,d=20+Math.random()*40,t=0;var iv=setInterval(function(){t+=.06;p.style.transform='translate('+Math.cos(a)*d*t+'px,'+(Math.sin(a)*d*t+t*t*30)+'px)';p.style.opacity=1-t;if(t>=1){clearInterval(iv);p.remove();}},16);})();}}
b.addEventListener('click',burst);burst();setInterval(burst,2000);</script>
